I switched from Selenium to Playwright a few years ago. I like it. But if I’m honest, the switch barely changed my work. Selenium was fine. Playwright is fine. When you know what you’re doing, the framework is just syntax — a set of method names wrapped around the same testing judgment you already have. I could go back to Selenium next week and write tests just as good. The framework was never the hard part.
What actually changed my work is AI. Not “I asked ChatGPT for a snippet” AI — the kind that lives inside your repo and does real work.
